annotations.title: Get a link to allow a mailbox's mail service in SPF

description: SPF lists the services allowed to send for a domain. Confirm with `consent: allow_mail_service` to get a signed link that creates the first SPF record for this connected mailbox's domain, with its mail service's include. The include comes from our verified mail provider settings, never from the caller. The DNS provider adds the record only after you approve on its page, then returns to `returnTo`. The link is offered only at DNS providers we have verified for it. Until one is, every answer has `url: null`: keep the manual steps from check_mailbox_domain. With no signing key, `reason` is `not_set_up`. Unknown mail services, DNS providers we don't offer, a domain that already has an SPF record, or too many DNS lookups (or lookups we can't count) answer `not_offered`. A failed lookup answers `unanswered`; retry before changing DNS. Returning proves nothing: call check_mailbox_domain again. Hosted addresses and send-only services are not supported.

consent.description: Confirm that you want to allow this mailbox's mail service to send for its domain. The DNS provider asks for approval before changing SPF.

returnTo.description: A console path, with its query if it has one, where the DNS provider sends the person back after they approve the record, like /acme/settings. Not a full address, and no # part. Left out, they land on the console's front page.
